interface_decisions.decision: Local Studio state is authoritative; GitHub receives redacted first-milestone counterparts and retry state only.
interface_decisions.example: A closed GitHub issue does not complete the corresponding Studio task.

interface_decisions.decision: OpenAPI plus architecture/privacy records freeze account, session, CSRF, simulated-adapter, data, and Swiss-storage boundaries before implementation.
interface_decisions.example: Provider publication is denied until simulated verification succeeds.

interface_decisions.decision: The flow document is the frontend source for role states, language behavior, labels, keyboard behavior, validation errors, and 390px/1280px layouts.
interface_decisions.example: Unsupported browser preference selects English and a visible switch persists only locally.

interface_decisions.decision: The backend owns persisted identities, password hashes, session/CSRF enforcement, role checks, and simulated verification/reset interfaces behind the accepted OpenAPI surface.
interface_decisions.example: An unverified customer reserve attempt returns the declared verification-required response.

interface_decisions.decision: The frontend consumes the accepted OpenAPI and flow contracts, owns UI resource keys and device-local language selection, and never translates provider-authored content.
interface_decisions.example: German UI copy can surround provider-authored English content without rewriting it.
